title: Complimenting a Nice Hand After Showdown
summaryJa: ポーカーテーブルで、ショーダウン後に相手の良いプレーを褒める友好的なやり取りです。トーナメントポーカーでは対戦相手と良好な関係を保つことが重要であり、このような自然な会話を英語でできるスキルは実戦で役立ちます。
segments: You: Thanks! You played it well too. I thought you might fold on the river.
Opponent: Yeah, I almost did. The turn card scared me a little.
You: Nice call. You had the right read.
Opponent: Thanks, man. Good luck with the rest of the tournament.
You: You too. Thanks for the friendly game.
